name: Caro Bot v5 (AlphaGomoku + Embryo)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runtime_hours:
        description: 'Runtime (hours)'
        required: false
        default: '5.9'
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'

jobs:
  run-bot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install websockets requests --break-system-packages

      - name: Run Caro Bot v5
        env:
          CARO_USER: ${{ secrets.CARO_USER }}
          CARO_PASSWD: ${{ secrets.CARO_PASSWD }}
          CARO_RUNTIME_HOURS: ${{ github.event.inputs.runtime_hours || '5.9' }}
        run: python3 bot5.py
